threat_event: Ransomware encrypts corporate IT (ERP, email, scheduling platform) and the attackers try to reach the OT DMZs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12,000 users and about 13,500 endpoints; energy companies are frequent targets; business tools the HOC relies on (scheduling, email) are on the IT side
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 to SYS-11; BP-07, BP-12 to BP-17; OT DMZs
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on all corporate endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; OT domain does not trust the corporate domain; annual tier-1 DR tests
treatment_plan: Annual enterprise ransomware exercise including the HOC and the disclosure committee (POAM-013); scheduling platform fallback drill; egress controls on the OT DMZ file transfer
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: State-sponsored actor pre-positions inside OT networks to enable a disruptive attack on gates and units during a crisis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long-dwell techniques that use legitimate tools; 24 of 35 plants have no OT network monitoring
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, Intrusion Detection; Form 3 Q14, Q33); C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-005-7 R1 Part 1.5)
existing_controls: Passive OT monitoring at both HOCs and 11 plants; E-ISAC, CISA, and HSIN Dams threat feeds; Intermediate Systems with MFA
treatment_plan: OT sensor rollout to all Group 1 and 2 gated plants first (POAM-003); annual threat hunt across OT with the retainer firm
key_risk_indicator: Plants with OT monitoring; threat hunt findings

threat_event: Attacker uses an always-on vendor connection or the password-only legacy VPN at the Piedmont plants to operate spillway gates or units at PD-04 or PD-06
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy VPN with passwords only; shared operator accounts; always-on vendor connections; no OT monitoring; PD-04 and PD-06 are Group 2 gated dams with downstream populations
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06; BP-09; PD-04 and PD-06 (and the BES plants PD-02, PD-04, PD-06)
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 3 and 6); C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, remote and third-party connections; Form 3 Q12)
existing_controls: Vendor connections disabled outside approved windows since 2026-09-18 (interim); night staffing at PD-04 and PD-06 during high flows; firewall allow-list on the VPN concentrator
treatment_plan: Replace the legacy VPN with the HOC Intermediate Systems, named accounts, and MFA; remove always-on vendor tools; OT sensors at all 9 PD plants (POAM-001, POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Always-on vendor connections remaining; shared accounts remaining; PD plants monitored

threat_event: Stolen credentials of a HOC operator or SCADA engineer are used for Interactive Remote Access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote engineering access is needed around the clock; MFA push fatigue and session token theft are known techniques
existing_controls: Intermediate Systems with hardware-token MFA; per-session approval; session recording; SOC alerts on unusual sessions
treatment_plan: Move remaining engineers from push MFA to hardware tokens (done for vendors); quarterly review of remote access rights
key_risk_indicator: Remote sessions without hardware tokens; anomalous session alerts

threat_event: Insider with operator rights deliberately misoperates spillway gates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 82 operators hold gate-operate rights; operators can act faster than review
existing_controls: Personnel risk assessments; SCADA limits on gate opening rates; command logging with named accounts; two-person rule for gate changes outside the operating plan
treatment_plan: Add SOC alerting on gate commands outside the operating plan bands
key_risk_indicator: Gate commands outside plan bands; PRA currency

threat_event: Attacker exploits an unsupported gate control workstation after lateral movement and issues gate commands
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 gate control workstations and 64 plant HMIs run an unsupported OS; no patches available
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, System Lifecycle; Form 3 Q15)
existing_controls: Isolation in the dam safety zone; application allowlisting; no internet or email on those hosts; exception EXC-2026-007
treatment_plan: Replace the 9 gate workstations first, then the 64 HMIs (POAM-005)

threat_event: Lateral movement from the plant control zone into the dam safety zone at plants without one-way gateways
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 35 plants use firewalls instead of data diodes between zones
existing_controls: Allow-list firewall rules reviewed every 6 months; SOC monitoring at HOC EAPs
treatment_plan: Add diodes or stricter rules at the 5 remaining Group 1 and 2 plants without diodes

threat_event: An intrusion at one of the 24 HOC-operated plants without OT network monitoring goes undetected long enough to cause harm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No passive OT sensors at 24 plants; legacy HMIs log locally only
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, Intrusion Detection; Form 3 Q14)
existing_controls: Firewall and historian alarms forwarded to the SOC; monthly logic comparisons at 21 plants
treatment_plan: OT sensors at all plants, Group 1 and 2 gated plants first (POAM-003)

threat_event: Falsified or blocked instrument data hides a developing dam failure mode
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dataloggers at 5 dams reachable through vendor cellular modems; readings trusted by trend review and AI-001
existing_controls: Trigger points checked by people; manual readings at High hazard dams; independent river gauges
treatment_plan: Remove cellular vendor paths (POAM-012); cross-check automated and manual readings monthly

threat_event: EAP warning sirens fail to sound, or sound falsely, because the siren control path is compromised or fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Siren activation from the HOC over the OT WAN; local activation available at each pole
existing_controls: Weekly silent tests; annual audible tests; local activation; county notification by phone tree
treatment_plan: Monitor siren controllers through the OT sensors; add tamper alarms at 2 remote poles

threat_event: Physical intrusion at a Group 1 or Group 2 dam with sabotage of gate hoists or control cabinets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote dams; long perimeters; recreation access near project works
existing_controls: Security Plans; cameras and intrusion detection at Group 1 and 2 dams; security officers at 6 dams; law enforcement coordination
treatment_plan: Close the DEV-04 Vulnerability Assessment reprint and DEV-03 Security Plan exercise (POAM-007)
key_risk_indicator: Intrusion alarms; Security Plan exercise currency

threat_event: HOC failover exceeds the 2-hour RTO during a flood or a loss of HOC-A, leaving gates on local control with stretched crews
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The 2026-05-16 failover took 3.4 hours: 95 minutes to staff HOC-B and the rest to resynchronize the SCADA database
existing_controls: HOC-B hot standby hardware; local control call-out plan by river system; annual failover exercise
treatment_plan: Standing night-shift crew at HOC-B; automated database resynchronization; retest by 2027-01-31 (POAM-010)

threat_event: PLC and gate logic copies older than 12 months at 14 plants prevent a clean, verified restore after compromise or failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Logic changes since the last copy are not captured; monthly logic comparison is not possible at those plants
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, Restoration and Recovery; Form 3 Q16)
existing_controls: Current copies at 21 plants; vendor copies of original logic
treatment_plan: Collect and verify copies at the 14 plants; quarterly copy schedule (POAM-008)
key_risk_indicator: Plants with logic copies older than 12 months

threat_event: Loss of real-time data exchange (ICCP) with the Balancing Authorities and Transmission Operators
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HOC-B ICCP has one carrier entrance
existing_controls: Second ICCP path through HOC-A; voice coordination on recorded lines
treatment_plan: Second carrier entrance at HOC-B (POAM-011)

threat_event: Compromise of the scheduling and trading platform causes wrong or missed day-ahead schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud-hosted single product; privileged trader roles
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; dual approval for bids over limits; warm standby; printed portal templates
treatment_plan: Quarterly privileged role review; schedule integrity checks against HOC plans

threat_event: A Blackstart Resource is unavailable when a Transmission Operator calls for restoration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote start depends on the HOC; local start procedures need trained crews on call
existing_controls: Local blackstart procedures; on-call crews at 6 plants; annual tests
treatment_plan: Add blackstart readiness checks to the monthly HOC report

threat_event: Wrong pumping setpoint at DEV-01 or DEV-03 overfills an upper reservoir (Group 1 dam)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pumping is controlled from the HOC; upper reservoirs are Group 1 dams
existing_controls: Independent high-level trips at both upper reservoirs; SCADA limits; operator alarms
treatment_plan: Annual test of the independent trips witnessed by dam safety staff

threat_event: A major flood coincides with a cyber incident or HOC outage (compound event)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Floods stretch crews already; local control needs operators at up to 36 gated dams
existing_controls: EAPs; call-out plans; flood operating procedures
treatment_plan: Joint flood and cyber exercise with county emergency management in 2027; pre-staged crews when major floods are forecast

threat_event: Hurricane damages DC-1 (Florida) and corporate systems run on DC-2 only
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 in a hurricane zone; 72 h fuel contract
existing_controls: ERP replica in DC-2; fuel contract; cloud backups
treatment_plan: Accepted: corporate processes tolerate 24 to 72 hours; reviewed annually

threat_event: Loss of station service and a standby generator failure prevent gate operation during a flood
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PD-07 missed its 2025 standby power load test (18 CFR 12.54(c))
existing_controls: Annual load tests at all other gated dams; portable generators and hand cranks
treatment_plan: Complete the PD-07 load test and add PD dams to the fleet test calendar (POAM-023)

threat_event: A telecom carrier outage at the 19 single-carrier plants puts them on local control during high water
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 19 plants have one carrier circuit and no microwave path
existing_controls: Local control by plant crews; satellite phones; carrier priority restoration agreement
treatment_plan: Diverse paths (second carrier or microwave) for the 19 plants, Group 1 and 2 first (POAM-011)

threat_event: Known vulnerabilities in the 64 unsupported plant HMIs are exploited to disrupt unit control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor patches; HMIs needed for local operation
existing_controls: Allowlisting; segmentation; no internet access
treatment_plan: Replacement program (POAM-005)

threat_event: Malicious code arrives on a contractor laptop or USB drive connected at a plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractors service plants weekly; 3 of 25 sampled visits had no kiosk scan record
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-010-4 R4; CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 5); C-DAMS-R01 (Form 3 Q17)
existing_controls: Scanning kiosks at every plant; USB blocking at HOCs
treatment_plan: Kiosk log check at plant entry; contractor briefing (POAM-015)

threat_event: Compromise or failure of the governor and exciter OEM affects 91 of 151 units
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One OEM services 60% of governors and exciters by remote session; 2025 renewal skipped CIP-013-2 terms; on-site fallback untested
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, acquisition standards; Form 3 Q32a); C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 6)
existing_controls: Sessions only through Intermediate Systems with recording; in-house I&C staff for routine work
treatment_plan: Contract amendment with CIP-013-2 terms; test the on-site fallback; second qualified service provider for 30% of units (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: OEM contract terms in place; fallback test

threat_event: A malicious update from the fleet SCADA vendor reaches both HOCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proprietary platform; updates go to both HOCs
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-010-4 R1 Part 1.6; CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.5)
existing_controls: Signature verification; test system staging; staggered deployment (HOC-B first)
treatment_plan: Request a software bill of materials at the next release

threat_event: An engineering contractor holding BCSI or CEII suffers a breach exposing fleet designs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 240 vendors have system or data access; engineering contractors hold drawings and diagrams
existing_controls: Handling agreements; vendor tiering; SOC report reviews
treatment_plan: Annual BCSI and CEII holder attestation from contractors

threat_event: A colocation provider outage takes DC-1 or DC-2 offline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two sites; mature providers
existing_controls: Two sites; provider SOC 2 reports
treatment_plan: Accepted; reviewed annually

threat_event: A Cloud provider B regional outage halts the DSMS and the SL-1 client portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DSMS ingestion in one region; standby region holds data only
existing_controls: Cross-region data replication; phone alerts to High hazard clients
treatment_plan: Active standby for ingestion (with POAM-020)
owner: Vice President, Dam Safety Monitoring Services

threat_event: The scheduling platform vendor fails or is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single product, no alternate
existing_controls: Balancing Authority portal fallback with printed templates; vendor SOC 2 review
treatment_plan: Accepted; fallback drilled annually

threat_event: A telecom carrier or managed service provider compromise is used as a path into the OT WAN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Carrier circuits carry OT traffic
existing_controls: Encrypted links; company-managed firewalls at every circuit end; carriers have no device access
treatment_plan: Annual review of carrier handoff configurations

threat_event: The Piedmont SCADA integrator is unavailable or compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One integrator for all 9 PD plants; no in-house knowledge yet; always-on connection
existing_controls: Local operators; interim session windows
treatment_plan: Train the OT team on the PD platform; replace the always-on connection (POAM-001)

threat_event: An intrusion at a Piedmont plant goes undetected because there is no OT monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT sensors or log forwarding at any PD plant
existing_controls: Firewall logs reviewed weekly by the OT security team since 2026-09
treatment_plan: OT sensors and log forwarding at all 9 PD plants (POAM-001)

threat_event: Shared operator accounts at Piedmont plants prevent attribution and fast revocation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared accounts on PD HMIs and the legacy VPN
existing_controls: Shift logs; password changes after staff departures
treatment_plan: Named accounts managed by OT PAM (POAM-002)

threat_event: Integration cutover connects weak Piedmont systems to the HOC or misconfigures gate control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex migration of 9 plants and 11 dams onto the HOC by 2027-03-31
existing_controls: Integration plan with security gates; P02 condition 5
treatment_plan: Pre-connection assessment of each PD plant; staged cutover with local control during each step

threat_event: CEII for the Piedmont dams (inundation maps, drawings) is exposed from general file shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PD records migrated into general shares at closing
existing_controls: Restricted CEII library for fleet records
treatment_plan: Move PD CEII into the restricted library; DLP rule (POAM-022)
key_risk_indicator: CEII files outside the restricted library

threat_event: BCSI for the HOCs is exposed through a contractor-shared project folder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HOC network diagrams found in a folder shared with an engineering contractor
existing_controls: BCSI repository with access lists; contractor handling agreement
treatment_plan: Remove the folder, review access history, assess as a potential CIP-011 noncompliance, and add BCSI DLP rules (POAM-006)

threat_event: Employee personal data (12,000 staff) is stolen from HR or payroll systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large HR data set; payroll SaaS
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (worked example; each state where affected individuals reside)
existing_controls: MFA; vendor SOC 2 review; DLP
treatment_plan: Data minimization in HR exports

threat_event: Recreation customer contact data is exposed through the reservations vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contact data only; card data on the vendor-hosted page
existing_controls: Vendor attestation; no card data stored
treatment_plan: Accepted; low impact

threat_event: Staff paste CEII or BCSI into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools are easy to reach; staff draft reports under time pressure
existing_controls: Public AI domains blocked on company devices since 2025; approved enterprise assistant (AI-010)
treatment_plan: Keep the block; approved tool excludes CEII and BCSI libraries

threat_event: FERC security documents (Vulnerability Assessments, Security Assessments, Security Plans) are mishandled or over-shared
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Documents circulate among plant, security, and engineering staff
existing_controls: Marking; restricted library; numbered printed copies
treatment_plan: Annual inventory of printed copies

threat_event: A DSMS ingestion outage beyond the 4-hour RTO delays dam safety alerts to SL-2 clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ingestion rebuild took 5.1 hours in test
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R02 (12.10(a); 12.3(b)(4)(viii)) (client duty supported by the service)
existing_controls: Data replicated to a second region; phone alerts to High hazard clients
treatment_plan: Automate the rebuild; retest (POAM-020)
owner: Vice President, Dam Safety Monitoring Services

threat_event: An uncontrolled change to DSMS alert thresholds or models suppresses alerts for client dams
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Thresholds and model versions change in the application without formal change control
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R02 (12.3(b)(4)(viii)) (client duty supported by the service)
existing_controls: Code changes through the pipeline; analyst review of alert volumes
treatment_plan: Threshold and model change control with dual approval and audit trail (POAM-019)
owner: Vice President, Dam Safety Monitoring Services
key_risk_indicator: Threshold changes without a change record

threat_event: Shared COC credentials at 6 SL-1 client endpoints allow untraceable or unauthorized operation of client plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 27 client VPN endpoints still use shared COC credentials
existing_controls: COC session logging; client approval of operating instructions
treatment_plan: Named credentials with MFA at all 27 endpoints, coordinated with the 11 clients (POAM-021)

threat_event: An attacker pivots between the COC and client plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: COC connects to 27 client plants through client-owned VPN endpoints
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, remote and third-party connections)
existing_controls: COC on its own network with no path to the HFCDMS; per-client segmentation
treatment_plan: Annual penetration test of the COC including client connection points

threat_event: SL-2 clients leave or contracts are lost because SL-2 has no SOC 2 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clients now ask for a SOC 2 Type 2 report; SL-1 has one, SL-2 does not
existing_controls: SL-2 readiness work started (P09)
treatment_plan: Close readiness gaps; start the SL-2 Type 2 period 2027-04-01 (P09)
owner: Vice President, Dam Safety Monitoring Services

threat_event: A client dam incident is linked to a missed DSMS alert, leading to liability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clients may rely on the service more than the contract allows
existing_controls: Contracts state clients keep their own surveillance duties; alert logs
treatment_plan: Accepted with contract terms and insurance; reviewed annually

threat_event: A material OT incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the disclosure committee has not exercised an OT or dam safety scenario
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three new committee members since 2026; no OT or dam safety tabletop
existing_controls: Materiality playbook; outside securities counsel on retainer
treatment_plan: Tabletop 2026-11-18 with an OT and dam safety scenario; playbook update (POAM-013)

threat_event: The Item 106 disclosure misdescribes cybersecurity processes (for example, Piedmont gaps)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure drafted by Legal from program documents
existing_controls: Internal Audit review of Item 106 statements; disclosure committee approval
treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests the Item 106 statements against P01 to P07 before the 10-K

threat_event: A SOX IT general control failure in ERP causes a reportable deficiency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual SOX testing; stable environment
existing_controls: SOX program testing
treatment_plan: Accepted; monitored by the SOX program

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects offtaker settlement or vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large payment flows with 4 offtakers and about 1,100 vendors
existing_controls: Call-back verification for bank changes; MFA
treatment_plan: Payment change analytics

threat_event: Potential NERC CIP violations (Piedmont Sections 3 and 6, late access removal, BCSI exposure) lead to penalties and mitigation plans
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three potential noncompliance issues found in 2026
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 3 and 6; CIP-004-7 R5; CIP-011-3 R1)
existing_controls: Self-reports to SERC on 2026-09-30; mitigation plans
treatment_plan: Complete mitigation plans (POAM-001, POAM-006, POAM-016); extend internal controls monitoring to newly acquired assets

threat_event: FERC finds Group 1 security documents out of date at inspection (DEV-04 Vulnerability Assessment reprint; DEV-03 Security Plan exercise)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reprint due 2026-03 is late; 5-year exercise interval passed 2025-10
existing_controls: Annual updates current for all 23 Group 1 and 2 dams
treatment_plan: Complete the reprint and exercise; disclose status in the 2026 certification letter (POAM-007)

threat_event: An 18 CFR 12.10 report is late because a cyber event at a plant is not recognized as a condition affecting safety
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cyber staff and dam safety staff use different triggers
existing_controls: Reporting procedure PRC-03.3 names cyber events as reportable conditions; Chief Dam Safety Engineer on the incident bridge
treatment_plan: Add 12.10 decision point to SOC case templates

threat_event: Undocumented vendor paths (cellular modems at dataloggers) bypass the Intermediate Systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three instrumentation vendors reach dataloggers at 5 dams directly
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9 Table 9.3a, remote and third-party connections; Form 3 Q12)
existing_controls: Found by P07; modems disabled except during approved sessions since 2026-09-02
treatment_plan: Remove the paths; vendor access only through the Intermediate Systems (POAM-012)

threat_event: A certification letter or 12.10 report contains an inaccurate statement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many statements across 23 dams; the 2025 letter reported PD-04 and PD-06 contact verification as complete when it was not (P03)
existing_controls: Second-line review by the Chief Compliance Officer; verification under 12.13
treatment_plan: Correct the 2025 statement with the Regional Engineer; evidence checklist for each letter statement before signing

threat_event: Access to CIP-scope systems or PSPs is not removed on time after a termination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor terminations reported late by vendors
existing_controls: Automated removal for employees; vendor notice terms
treatment_plan: Daily contractor roster reconciliation; vendor notice clause enforcement (POAM-016)

threat_event: Patch evaluation or mitigation plans for HOC Cyber Assets miss the 35-day cycle
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mature process; vendor releases are frequent
existing_controls: Tracking tool with due-date alerts
treatment_plan: Accepted; monitored monthly by NERC compliance

threat_event: A zero-day in a corporate edge device (VPN or firewall) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices are frequent targets
existing_controls: Emergency patch SLA of 72 hours; SOC monitoring; the OT domain does not trust the corporate domain
treatment_plan: Retire the Piedmont legacy VPN (POAM-001); reduce exposed edge services

threat_event: Phishing compromises an engineer's corporate account, and the attacker tries to pivot to OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers hold both corporate and OT accounts
existing_controls: Separate OT identities; phishing training; MFA
treatment_plan: Targeted phishing exercises for OT staff
key_risk_indicator: Phishing failure rate for OT staff

threat_event: AI-001 misses a developing failure mode and staff rely on it (automation bias)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Anomaly detection runs on 44 company dams and 138 client dams
existing_controls: Manual trigger-point checks unchanged; council review
treatment_plan: AI-001 conditions in P10, including disparity testing and change control (POAM-018, POAM-019)

threat_event: AI use cases run without AI council review (4 of 11)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Use cases entered through vendor features before the intake rule
existing_controls: Intake block in procurement since 2026-03
treatment_plan: Council reviews of the 4 use cases (POAM-018)

threat_event: An inflow forecasting model gives wrong reservoir guidance that operators follow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Forecasts support reservoir planning (AI-004)
existing_controls: Forecasts are advisory; operating plans and rule curves govern gate settings
treatment_plan: Prohibit direct use of model output for gate settings; operators follow the operating plan

threat_event: The enterprise generative AI assistant exposes CEII to internal users who should not see it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The assistant indexes file shares the user can reach
existing_controls: CEII and BCSI libraries excluded from indexing
treatment_plan: Accepted with exclusions; reviewed quarterly

threat_event: Loss of key OT staff and knowledge (SCADA engineers, retirements) slows recovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small SCADA engineering team; retirements expected
existing_controls: Cross-training; vendor support
treatment_plan: Succession plan and documented runbooks for critical OT tasks

threat_event: Drone overflight or surveillance of Group 1 dams supports attack planning
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drone use near dams is common and hard to stop
existing_controls: Suspicious activity reporting to FERC and HSIN Dams; officer patrols
treatment_plan: Add drone sightings to the HSIN reporting checklist
